title: Elemental
tagline: Fire meets water. Dinner meets you.
about: A fiery young woman and a soft-hearted water guy fall for each other in Element City.
cue: Serve the snacks when Ember works the counter at her family's shop.
faces: Open 4 pm to midnight, not Mondays.
+ Element City's water canals and lifts
Lumen family shop. One blue flame, always lit.
Sit, Ember. Eat the hot snacks while they glow, the blue flame cooked them for us.
Cashews and peanuts roasted with honey, chilli and smoked paprika.
Cucumber rounds topped with whipped feta and yoghurt.
Charcoal grilled halloumi with chilli honey
Too hot for Wade. He'll cry anyway.
Lamb shoulder braised with harissa, cumin, tomato and chickpeas.
Dinner with Wade's family in their high-rise.
Meringue topped with whipped cream, blueberries and edible purple flowers.
Apple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and ginger.
Ember's flame keeps it hot to the last sip.
One of every course, packed in one bag, ready by the opening credits.
Kitchen tip: Serve the snacks when Ember works the counter at her family's shop. Overheard: The blue flame the family carried over. Prices subject to change. Form TK 23. Poster and stills: TMDB.

    StartersFireplace shop hot nutsCashews and peanuts roasted with honey, chilli and smoked paprikaHow to make it200g cashews200g peanuts2 tbsp honey1/2 tsp chilli flakes1/2 tsp smoked paprikaToss the cashews and peanuts with the honey, chilli flakes and paprika.Spread on a lined tray.Roast at 170°C until glossy.Cool until crunchy.Feta cucumber roundsCucumber rounds topped with whipped feta and yoghurtHow to make it2 Lebanese cucumbers150g feta150g Greek yoghurt1/2 lemon2 tbsp dill, choppedcracked pepper, to tasteSlice the cucumbers into thick rounds.Whip the feta, yoghurt and a squeeze of lemon until smooth.Pipe or spoon onto each round.Finish with dill and cracked pepper.Firetown harissa flatbreads with labnehFiretown, where Ember grew upHow to make itAs written, serves 4Flatbreads brushed with harissa stirred into olive oil, grilled until charred at the edges, torn and served with thick labneh.Mix 300g self-raising flour with 300g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 1 minute.Divide into 4 and roll each into a thin oval.Stir 2 tbsp harissa into 3 tbsp olive oil.Cook the flatbreads on a very hot dry pan or grill for 2 minutes a side until puffed and charred at the edges, brushing with the harissa oil as they come off.Spread 250g labneh on a plate, drizzle with oil and za'atar and serve with the torn flatbreads.Charcoal grilled halloumi with chilli honeyToo hot for Wade. cumin.Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and water.Cover and braise at 160°C until it pulls apart.Warm the flatbread and serve alongside.Ripple family ginger poached salmonDinner with Wade's family in their
